Math

Inline

Euler: e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0. Bold: \textbf{test}. Blackboard: \mathbb{R}^n.

Underscores and stars stay TeX, not emphasis: a_1 * b_2 * c_3 and x^*.

Backtick form, for a $ inside: \text{cost} = \$5.

Math in a heading's text and in bold x and a link y.

Escaped dollars stay text: $5 and $10. So do $5 and $10.

Two on a line: a and b, adjacent ab.

Display

\begin{aligned} \nabla \cdot \mathbf{E} &= \frac{\rho}{\varepsilon_0} \\ \nabla \times \mathbf{B} &= \mu_0 \mathbf{J} \end{aligned}

\sum_{k=1}^n k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}

A matrix:

A = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{pmatrix}

\int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2} \, dx = \sqrt{\pi}
f(x) = \begin{cases} x & x \ge 0 \\ -x & x < 0 \end{cases}
